activities.cueEnglish: Find when the friend ate the breakfast cake.
activities.modelJapanese: 八時十分ごろ、友人が朝食のケーキを一切れ食べました。
activities.modelEnglish: At about 8:10, my friend ate a slice of breakfast cake.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name hives in Japanese.
Listen for the hives, lip swelling, and breathing difficulty.
activities.modelJapanese: その後、腕にじんましんが出て、唇が腫れ、息苦しいと話しました。
activities.modelEnglish: After that, she had hives on her arms, her lips swelled, and she said she had difficulty breathing.

activities.cueEnglish: Type when the speaker called local emergency services.
activities.modelJapanese: すぐに現地の救急サービスに通報しました。正確な時刻は記録を確認します。
activities.modelEnglish: I called local emergency services right away. I will check the record for the exact time.

activities.cueEnglish: Tell the duty manager what happened when responders arrived.
activities.modelJapanese: 救急隊が来たときはめまいが強く、その後、救急車で病院へ運ばれました。
activities.modelEnglish: She was very dizzy when responders arrived, then was taken to hospital by ambulance.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the kitchen said about almond flour.
activities.modelJapanese: 厨房の説明では、ケーキにアーモンド粉が入っていたそうです。
activities.modelEnglish: According to the kitchen, the cake contained almond flour.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the mismatch between the gluten-free sign and the ingredient list.
activities.modelJapanese: 待ってください。このトレーにはグルテンフリーの表示がありますが、原材料に小麦粉と書いてあります。
activities.modelEnglish: Please wait. This tray has a gluten-free sign, but the ingredient list says wheat flour.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name celiac disease in Japanese.
Listen for what the guest nearly ate and why they checked first.
activities.modelJapanese: セリアック病があり、もう少しで食べるところでした。先に原材料を見てよかったです。
activities.modelEnglish: I have celiac disease and almost ate it. I am glad I read the ingredients first.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the request to check the preparation area and shared utensils.
activities.modelJapanese: 調理場所や共用の器具についても確認できますか。
activities.modelEnglish: Could you also check the preparation area and shared utensils?

activities.cueEnglish: Suggest how the baker can recheck a product and tray before placing a sign.
activities.modelJapanese: 次からは表示を置く前に、製品とトレーを再確認するのはどうですか。
activities.modelEnglish: For next time, how about rechecking the product and tray before placing a sign?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the guest will do if the bread cannot be verified.
activities.modelJapanese: 確認できない場合は、今日は食べないことにします。
activities.modelEnglish: If it cannot be verified, I will not eat it today.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the instruction that points guests to the emergency exit.
activities.modelJapanese: 皆さん、係員の案内を聞いてください。非常口はこちらです。
activities.modelEnglish: Everyone, please listen to staff. The emergency exit is this way.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name evacuation in Japanese.
Listen for the instruction about the elevator and stairs.
activities.modelJapanese: エレベーターは使わず、案内された階段へ進んでください。
activities.modelEnglish: Do not use the elevator; proceed to the stairs staff indicate.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the question about the meeting point.
activities.modelJapanese: 集合場所はどこですか。

activities.cueEnglish: Tell staff that someone needs help moving.
activities.modelJapanese: 歩くのに手助けが必要な方がいます。係員に伝えます。
activities.modelEnglish: Someone needs help moving. I will tell staff.

activities.cueEnglish: Write your room number and location at the meeting point.
activities.modelJapanese: 五〇四号室です。指定の集合場所で待っています。
activities.modelEnglish: I am in room 504. We are waiting at the designated meeting point.
